description: Official monthly store sales (and cost) by store country and product family. Finance's approved definition — do not re-derive.

query.name: certified-monthly-store-sales-by-country
query.mdx: SELECT NON EMPTY {[Measures].[Store Sales], [Measures].[Store Cost]} ON COLUMNS, NON EMPTY {([Time].[Month].Members, [Product].[Product Family].Members)} ON ROWS FROM [Sales]
